summary: Publishes the backend OpenAPI contract as downloadable JSON, split into eight area documents with component references, operation ids, tags and declared security.
userImpact: Developers can download /api/docs/openapi.json or one area document such as /api/docs/engines.json, and switch between documents in Swagger UI at /api/docs.

changes: Published documents reference registered schemas instead of inlining them, omit internal authorization metadata, and document tenant routes once under /api/t/{tenantSlug}.

security: The published documents no longer expose internal authorization action ids, resolvers or risk ratings; the internal contract used by the authorization guards is unchanged.
documentation: Adds generated OpenAPI YAML documents under docs/reference/openapi with a drift and lint check in CI.
rollback: Revert to the previous image; the documentation routes hold no state.
validation: Schema contract tests, the authorization route inventory, and the new published-document tests pass.
